newsitem.title: USA: Optical Data named subcontractor on contract.
newsitem.headline: Optical Data named subcontractor on contract.

text.p: Optical Data Systems Inc said it has been selected as data communications subcontractor to Motorola Inc's Space and Systems Technology Group (SSTG) on the Theater Deployable Communications (TDC) Integrated Communications Access Packages Program with the U.S. Air Force.

The company said TDC was initiated to develop a new, advanced, rapid deployment communications network for the Air Force wings, operations centers, combat communications units and special operations squadrons.
Optical Data said it will supply field deployable data communications systems providing the Air Force cost-effective access to newer technologies without requiring expensive upgrades.
